name: Ultimate Town Sandbox
desc:
THIS GAME IS STILL IN BETA AND HAS MANY FEATURES MISSING OR UNFINISHED!

🗺️ Explore the town of Vitex, located on Matthiola Isle. Ultimate Town Sandbox is what it says. You can do whatever you want, with (almost) no limits. Meet NPCs, work jobs, fight enemies, blow things up, drive cars, fly helicopters, dumpster dive, race, and so much more.

⚠️ This game can be very heavy to run! Your device should have 4 GB of RAM minimum, and 8 GB+ is recommended.

🎮 Controls can be found by pressing the controller icon in the inventory.
For controller/console, press Select to access the virtual cursor.

Premium players have a chance to get Premium customers at jobs. These customers give 5x Cash, 3x Customers, and 2x XP.

Tags: Town, Roleplay, City, Jobs, Houses, Vehicles, Cars, Boats, Helicopters, Police, Moods, Inventory, NPC, FPS, Enemies, Customization
